collection.title: Naruto Card Collection - All 186 Cards | Naruto Mythos TCG
collection.description: Explore the complete collection of all 186 Naruto Mythos TCG cards. Browse Common, Uncommon, Rare, Rare Art, Secret, and Mythos rarity cards. Filter by rarity, village (Leaf, Sand, Sound, Akatsuki), keyword (Sannin, Team 7, Summon), and character type. View official card artwork, chakra cost and power stats, and detailed effect descriptions for every card. Discover iconic characters like Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, Kakashi Hatake, Itachi, Gaara, Sakura Haruno, Jiraiya, Orochimaru, and Tsunade in this free Naruto Shippuden card encyclopedia.

deckBuilder.title: Naruto Deck Builder - Create Your Strategy | Naruto Mythos TCG
deckBuilder.description: Build the perfect deck in Naruto Mythos TCG with our interactive deck builder. Choose from 66 illustrated playable cards, select 3 mission cards, and validate your composition (minimum 30 character cards, maximum 2 copies per version). Drag-and-drop or click to add cards, filter by rarity and village, and preview every card in real-time. Save your decks online and load them to play against AI or in multiplayer. Craft strategies with Leaf Village, Sand Village, Akatsuki, and more cards.

leaderboard.title: Player ELO Rankings - Top Competitive Players | Naruto Mythos TCG
leaderboard.description: View the official Naruto Mythos TCG ELO rankings updated in real-time. Discover the top competitive players with detailed statistics: ELO score, wins, losses, draws, win ratio, and performance history. Track your progress in the global rankings, compare your results with top players, and climb the ladder through ranked multiplayer matches. The ELO ranking system uses an adaptive K-factor for balanced and competitive matchmaking.

friends.title: Friends List - Manage Your Contacts | Naruto Mythos TCG
friends.description: Manage your friends list on Naruto Mythos TCG. Send and accept friend requests, view your contacts' profiles, challenge them to private matches, and track their online activity. Build your Naruto Shippuden player community.

register.description: Create your Naruto Mythos TCG account for free in seconds. Access online multiplayer, save your decks, compete in ELO ranked matches, add friends, and climb the global leaderboard. Quick and free registration to start playing the Naruto Shippuden card game online.

playAi.title: Play vs AI - 4 Difficulty Levels | Naruto Mythos TCG
playAi.description: Challenge the Naruto Mythos TCG artificial intelligence across 4 difficulty levels. Easy mode to learn the basics, Medium for balanced strategy, Hard with minimax and optimal chakra management, and Expert with advanced SCORE effect evaluation, multi-turn planning, and hidden card probability analysis. Choose your custom deck and launch a solo game instantly. Perfect for training before ranked online matches or discovering the Naruto Shippuden card game.

playOnline.title: Play Online - Real-Time Multiplayer | Naruto Mythos TCG
playOnline.description: Play Naruto Mythos TCG online against other players from around the world in real-time. Create a private room with a 6-character code to play with friends or use public matchmaking to find an opponent at your skill level. Compete in ranked matches to earn ELO points and climb the global leaderboard. Every action is server-validated for a fair and secure gaming experience. Challenge the community, improve your strategy, and become the best Naruto Shippuden card game player.

legal.privacyIntro: Protecting your personal data is important to us. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it and what your rights are.
legal.dataCollectedText:
When you register and use the site, we collect the following data:
- Username (chosen by you)
- Email address
- Password (stored in hashed form, never in plain text)
- Game statistics (ELO, wins, losses, draws)
- Created and saved decks
- Game history
- Discord ID (if you voluntarily link your account)
legal.dataPurposeText:
Your data is used exclusively for:
- Creating and managing your player account
- Operating the ranking system (ELO)
- Saving your decks and game replays
- Online matchmaking and game room management
- Optional Discord integration (rank notifications)
- In-game chat moderation
legal.dataStorageText: Your data is stored in a MongoDB database hosted on secure servers. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Communications are encrypted via HTTPS. No payment data is collected (the service is entirely free).
legal.dataDurationText: Your data is retained as long as your account is active. Game replays are automatically deleted after 7 days. You may request deletion of your account and all your data at any time.
legal.dataSharingText:
We do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. The only sharing is with:
- IONOS (VPS server hosting)
- MongoDB Atlas (data storage)
- Discord (if you link your account, only your Discord ID)
- TopDeck.gg (only for querying their public APIs to display tournaments; no personal data is sent to them)
legal.topdeckDataText:
The TopDeck tab displays Naruto Mythos tournaments and events sourced from the third-party platform TopDeck.gg. This data is:
- Fetched from TopDeck.gg's public API (completed tournaments with standings) and its Event Hub (upcoming events).
- Cached on our server to minimize requests to TopDeck.gg.
- Shown with the mandatory credit "Data provided by TopDeck.gg" and a link back to the original page for registration or details.
TopDeck.gg is responsible for the accuracy of its own data. For any question about a specific tournament, please contact TopDeck.gg or the event organizer directly.
legal.geolocationText:
On the TopDeck page, the application asks for your geographic position (via the standard browser API) to sort events by distance. This permission is strictly optional:
- You can accept or refuse at any time; refusing does not prevent using the site, events will simply be sorted by date.
- Your position is sent to our server only for the duration of a request, to compute distances, and is never stored or shared with any third party.
- The permission is managed by your browser; to revoke it, use your browser settings.
legal.cookiesText: This site uses only essential technical cookies required for the service to function (authentication session). No advertising or tracking cookies are used.
legal.userRightsText:

- Right to access your personal data
